2610.10507.title: RECAST: Learning to Compute the Right Context through Adaptive Evidence Routing
2610.10507.paper_summary: Large language models are increasingly applied to tasks grounded in long, heterogeneous information sources. Conventional Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) relies on fixed similarity-based retrieval, while agentic variants adapt queries and tool use but remain largely retrieval-centric. However, in many tasks, the evidence required for a solution is not explicitly present in any single source item. Instead, it must be derived through filtering, aggregation, or computation across multiple source items. In this work, we introduce RECAST (Routing Evidence through Computation, Access, and Synthesized Tools), a learned framework that formulates evidence construction as a sequential decision process over heterogeneous retrieval and computation operations, allowing evidence to be actively derived rather than merely retrieved. A lightweight RouterLM iteratively selects and formulates primitive operations or specifies customized operations for a frozen CompilerLM to translate into executable code. Once it judges the evidence sufficient, RouterLM passes the accepted evidence to a frozen AnswerLM to produce the final solution. We train RouterLM with supervised fine-tuning (SFT) followed by group relative policy optimization (GRPO). Across six heterogeneous benchmark families, RECAST achieves a mean success rate of 75.6%, outperforming the strongest large-model baseline by 15.9%. Moreover, training enables the Qwen3.5-9B RouterLM to outperform a training-free Gemini 3.5 Flash RouterLM by 5.0%. On three held-out benchmarks, RECAST improves over the strongest baseline by 15.0% on average, demonstrating strong zero-shot generalization across tasks and heterogeneous source representations.
2610.10507.paper_summary_zh: 大型語言模型越來越多地應用於基於長期、多樣化信息來源的任務中。傳統的檢索增強生成（RAG）依賴於固定的相似性基礎檢索，而代理變體則調整查詢和工具使用，但仍然主要以檢索為中心。然而，在許多任務中，解決方案所需的證據並不明確存在於任何單一來源項目中。相反，這些證據必須通過過濾、聚合或計算從多個來源項目中推導出來。在這項工作中，我們介紹了RECAST（通過計算、訪問和綜合工具路由證據），這是一個學習框架，將證據構建公式化為一個關於異質檢索和計算操作的序列決策過程，允許證據被主動推導而不僅僅是檢索。輕量級的RouterLM迭代選擇和公式化原始操作，或為凍結的CompilerLM指定自定義操作，以轉換為可執行代碼。一旦它判斷證據足夠，RouterLM將接受的證據傳遞給凍結的AnswerLM以產生最終解決方案。我們使用監督微調（SFT）訓練RouterLM，然後進行群體相對策略優化（GRPO）。在六個異質基準系列中，RECAST達到了75.6%的平均成功率，超過了最強大型模型基線15.9%。此外，訓練使得Qwen3.5-9B RouterLM在性能上超越了一個無需訓練的Gemini 3.5 Flash RouterLM，達到5.0%的優勢。在三個保留的基準上，RECAST在平均上比最強基線提高了15.0%，顯示出在任務和異質來源表示上的強大零樣本泛化能力。
